data_layout: data/index.json binds three manifests, each binding128 zstd point shards and JSON receipts
metadata_archive_contents: All raw run files except data/; includes executable, protocol, controls, host, logs, terminal, development validation, full original manifest
reconstruction: Extract metadata archive, then put the preserved data directory under data/; sha256sum -c manifest.sha256 checks the complete original run
point_payload_store: Per-family .artifacts.json maps each shard to store/sha256/<first2>/<sha256> in setec-astronomy-artifacts
retention: Original raw directory remains intact. All failures and partial uploader diagnostics preserved.
